```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6
)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

# 1. Load Cleaned Data

```{r load-data}
df <- read.csv(
  "Cleaned Data/january_cleaned.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

df$FL_DATE <- as.Date(df$FL_DATE)

cat("Number of rows:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Number of columns:", ncol(df), "\n")
cat("Date range:", as.character(min(df$FL_DATE)),
    "to", as.character(max(df$FL_DATE)), "\n")

head(df)
```

# 2. Dataset Overview

## 2.1 Dataset Structure

```{r dataset-structure}
str(df)
```

## 2.2 Data Types and Missing Values

```{r data-types}
data_overview <- data.frame(
  Column = names(df),
  Data_Type = sapply(df, function(x) class(x)[1]),
  Missing_Values = colSums(is.na(df)),
  Missing_Percentage = round(
    colMeans(is.na(df)) * 100, 2
  )
)

data_overview
```

## 2.3 Summary Statistics

```{r summary-statistics}
summary(df)
```

## 2.4 Daily Flight Volume

```{r flight-by-date}
flights_by_date <- df %>%
  group_by(FL_DATE) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Flights = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(flights_by_date,
       aes(x = FL_DATE, y = Total_Flights)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Flight Volume in January 2025",
    x = "Flight Date",
    y = "Number of Flights"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 3. Arrival Delay Analysis

## 3.1 Descriptive Statistics of Arrival Delay

```{r arrival-delay-summary}
delay_statistics <- data.frame(
  Mean = mean(df$ARR_DELAY, na.rm = TRUE),
  Median = median(df$ARR_DELAY, na.rm = TRUE),
  Standard_Deviation = sd(df$ARR_DELAY, na.rm = TRUE),
  Minimum = min(df$ARR_DELAY, na.rm = TRUE),
  Maximum = max(df$ARR_DELAY, na.rm = TRUE),
  Q1 = quantile(df$ARR_DELAY, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
  Q3 = quantile(df$ARR_DELAY, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
)

delay_statistics
```

## 3.2 Overall Arrival Delay Distribution

```{r delay-histogram}
ggplot(df, aes(x = ARR_DELAY)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 10,
    fill = "steelblue",
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Arrival Delays",
    subtitle = "All January 2025 flights",
    x = "Arrival Delay (minutes)",
    y = "Number of Flights"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 3.3 Arrival Delay Distribution (Focused Range)

This graph focuses on delays between -60 and 300 minutes to make the main distribution easier to observe.

```{r delay-histogram-focused}
ggplot(
  filter(df, ARR_DELAY >= -60, ARR_DELAY <= 300),
  aes(x = ARR_DELAY)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 10,
    fill = "steelblue",
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Arrival Delay Distribution (-60 to 300 Minutes)",
    x = "Arrival Delay (minutes)",
    y = "Number of Flights"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 3.4 Arrival Delay Boxplot

```{r delay-boxplot}
ggplot(df, aes(y = ARR_DELAY)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Boxplot of Arrival Delays",
    y = "Arrival Delay (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 4. Target Variable Analysis

## 4.1 Major Delay Distribution (30 Minutes)

```{r target-30}
target_30 <- df %>%
  count(major_delay_30) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2),
    Status = ifelse(
      major_delay_30 == 1,
      "Delay >= 30 minutes",
      "Delay < 30 minutes"
    )
  )

target_30

ggplot(target_30, aes(x = Status, y = n, fill = Status)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(n, " (", Percentage, "%)")),
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Flights by 30-Minute Delay",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Flights"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## 4.2 Major Delay Distribution (60 Minutes)

```{r target-60}
target_60 <- df %>%
  count(major_delay_60) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2),
    Status = ifelse(
      major_delay_60 == 1,
      "Delay >= 60 minutes",
      "Delay < 60 minutes"
    )
  )

target_60

ggplot(target_60, aes(x = Status, y = n, fill = Status)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(n, " (", Percentage, "%)")),
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Flights by 60-Minute Delay",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Flights"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# 5. Flight Analysis by Origin Airport

## 5.1 Number of Flights by Airport

```{r airport-volume}
airport_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(ORIGIN) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Flights = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Flights))

airport_summary

ggplot(
  airport_summary,
  aes(
    x = reorder(ORIGIN, Total_Flights),
    y = Total_Flights
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Flight Volume by Origin Airport",
    x = "Origin Airport",
    y = "Number of Flights"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 5.2 Delay Rate by Origin Airport

```{r airport-delay-rate}
airport_delay <- df %>%
  group_by(ORIGIN) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Flights = n(),
    Delayed_30 = sum(major_delay_30 == 1),
    Delay_Rate_30 = mean(major_delay_30) * 100,
    Delayed_60 = sum(major_delay_60 == 1),
    Delay_Rate_60 = mean(major_delay_60) * 100,
    Average_Delay = mean(ARR_DELAY),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Delay_Rate_30))

airport_delay

ggplot(
  airport_delay,
  aes(
    x = reorder(ORIGIN, Delay_Rate_30),
    y = Delay_Rate_30
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "coral") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "30-Minute Delay Rate by Origin Airport",
    x = "Origin Airport",
    y = "Delay Rate (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 5.3 Average Arrival Delay by Airport

```{r airport-average-delay}
ggplot(
  airport_delay,
  aes(
    x = reorder(ORIGIN, Average_Delay),
    y = Average_Delay
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Arrival Delay by Origin Airport",
    x = "Origin Airport",
    y = "Average Arrival Delay (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 7. Temporal Analysis

## 7.1 Delay Rate by Day of Week

Day of week: Sunday = 0, Monday = 1, ..., Saturday = 6.

```{r delay-by-day}
day_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(day_of_week) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Flights = n(),
    Delay_Rate_30 = mean(major_delay_30) * 100,
    Average_Delay = mean(ARR_DELAY),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

day_summary$Day <- factor(
  day_summary$day_of_week,
  levels = 0:6,
  labels = c(
    "Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday",
    "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"
  )
)

day_summary

ggplot(day_summary, aes(x = Day, y = Delay_Rate_30)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "30-Minute Delay Rate by Day of Week",
    x = "Day of Week",
    y = "Delay Rate (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 7.2 Delay Rate by Scheduled Departure Hour

```{r delay-by-departure-hour}
hour_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(scheduled_departure_hour) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Flights = n(),
    Delay_Rate_30 = mean(major_delay_30) * 100,
    Average_Delay = mean(ARR_DELAY),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hour_summary

ggplot(
  hour_summary,
  aes(
    x = scheduled_departure_hour,
    y = Delay_Rate_30
  )
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:23) +
  labs(
    title = "30-Minute Delay Rate by Scheduled Departure Hour",
    x = "Scheduled Departure Hour",
    y = "Delay Rate (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 7.3 Average Arrival Delay by Departure Hour

```{r average-delay-by-hour}
ggplot(
  hour_summary,
  aes(
    x = scheduled_departure_hour,
    y = Average_Delay
  )
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:23) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Arrival Delay by Departure Hour",
    x = "Scheduled Departure Hour",
    y = "Average Arrival Delay (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 8. Route Analysis

## 8.1 Top 15 Routes by Flight Volume

```{r top-routes}
route_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(ORIGIN, DEST) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Flights = n(),
    Delay_Rate_30 = mean(major_delay_30) * 100,
    Average_Delay = mean(ARR_DELAY),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

top_routes <- route_summary %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Flights)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

top_routes

ggplot(
  top_routes,
  aes(
    x = reorder(
      paste(ORIGIN, DEST, sep = "-"),
      Total_Flights
    ),
    y = Total_Flights
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Routes by Flight Volume",
    x = "Route",
    y = "Number of Flights"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 8.2 Delay Rate by Top 15 Routes

```{r route-delay-rate}
ggplot(
  top_routes,
  aes(
    x = reorder(
      paste(ORIGIN, DEST, sep = "-"),
      Delay_Rate_30
    ),
    y = Delay_Rate_30
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "coral") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "30-Minute Delay Rate of Top 15 Routes",
    x = "Route",
    y = "Delay Rate (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 9. Numerical Variable Analysis

## 9.1 Flight Distance Distribution

```{r distance-distribution}
summary(df$DISTANCE)

ggplot(df, aes(x = DISTANCE)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 100,
    fill = "steelblue",
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Flight Distance",
    x = "Distance (miles)",
    y = "Number of Flights"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 9.2 Scheduled Elapsed Time Distribution

```{r elapsed-time-distribution}
summary(df$CRS_ELAPSED_TIME)

ggplot(df, aes(x = CRS_ELAPSED_TIME)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 15,
    fill = "steelblue",
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Scheduled Flight Duration",
    x = "Scheduled Elapsed Time (minutes)",
    y = "Number of Flights"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 9.3 Distance vs Arrival Delay

```{r distance-vs-delay}
ggplot(df, aes(x = DISTANCE, y = ARR_DELAY)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Flight Distance vs Arrival Delay",
    x = "Distance (miles)",
    y = "Arrival Delay (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 9.4 Scheduled Elapsed Time vs Arrival Delay

```{r elapsed-vs-delay}
ggplot(
  df,
  aes(x = CRS_ELAPSED_TIME, y = ARR_DELAY)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Scheduled Flight Duration vs Arrival Delay",
    x = "Scheduled Elapsed Time (minutes)",
    y = "Arrival Delay (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 10. Correlation Analysis

```{r correlation}
numeric_data <- df %>%
  select(
    ARR_DELAY,
    DISTANCE,
    CRS_ELAPSED_TIME,
    scheduled_departure_hour,
    scheduled_arrival_hour
  )

correlation_matrix <- cor(
  numeric_data,
  use = "complete.obs"
)

round(correlation_matrix, 3)
```

# 11. Final EDA Summary

```{r final-summary}
final_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Total Flights",
    "Average Arrival Delay",
    "Median Arrival Delay",
    "Maximum Arrival Delay",
    "Flights Delayed >= 30 Minutes",
    "30-Minute Delay Rate (%)",
    "Flights Delayed >= 60 Minutes",
    "60-Minute Delay Rate (%)",
    "Number of Origin Airports",
    "Number of Airlines",
    "Number of Routes"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(df),
    round(mean(df$ARR_DELAY), 2),
    median(df$ARR_DELAY),
    max(df$ARR_DELAY),
    sum(df$major_delay_30 == 1),
    round(mean(df$major_delay_30) * 100, 2),
    sum(df$major_delay_60 == 1),
    round(mean(df$major_delay_60) * 100, 2),
    n_distinct(df$ORIGIN),
    n_distinct(df$OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER),
    n_distinct(paste(df$ORIGIN, df$DEST))
  )
)

final_summary
```
